_policy: This file backs the instant '≈' numbers shown while the exact, debounced
API count is in flight. A family whose ratio is null produces NO estimate
— the UI shows '—', never a fabricated number.
`calibrated: false` means the ratio is DERIVED from published statements,
not measured against the provider's own counting endpoint. The API
propagates this flag so the UI widens the error band and softens the
wording. Replace these with measured values by running:
which requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and writes measured ratios plus real
p50/p90 error bands back into this file.
base_note: Ratios multiply the tiktoken o200k_base count of the same text.

anthropic_pre_4_7.source: Anthropic API reference (bundled claude-api skill): tiktoken undercounts Claude tokens by ~15-20% on typical text, and by more on code and non-English input. 1.18 is the midpoint of that stated range.
anthropic_pre_4_7.notes: DERIVED, NOT MEASURED. Known to be worst on code and non-Latin scripts, where the true ratio is higher.

anthropic_4_7_plus.source: Derived from two published figures: (1) tiktoken undercounts the older Claude tokenizer by ~15-20% (midpoint 1.18) per the Anthropic API reference; (2) the official Anthropic pricing page states the Claude 4.7-and-later tokenizer 'produces approximately 30% more tokens for the same text' than the previous generation. 1.18 x 1.30 = 1.534.
anthropic_4_7_plus.notes: DERIVED BY MULTIPLYING TWO PUBLISHED RANGES — the compounded uncertainty is wide, and this ratio has not been measured against count_tokens even once. It exists so the placeholder is not obviously wrong (a single 1.18 ratio would understate Opus 5 by roughly 30%), NOT because it is accurate. Calibrate before this figure is shown without a prominent caveat.

google.notes: No sourced ratio available for any Gemini model. Deliberately null: Gemini shows no estimate at all until the debounced exact count lands. Showing '—' is correct; inventing a ratio is not.

content_class_multipliers._notes: Applied on top of the family ratio once fitted per class. All null until calibration runs.
